title: Readable/Unencrypted EnchantingTable Letters
description: Makes the particles and the font of the enchanting table readable
body:
This resource pack lets you **read the mysterious letters** on the enchanting table.
Note: I **didn’t** choose the wording — Mojang wrote these lines, translated them, and I then **translated them back**.

![The image shoes the Enchanting Table and the GUI of it, with readable letters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02f1f0caee9b504b4d8921a30f6fb391b2a2a5a6.png)

Known **Bugs**:
> Small Bugs:
- > Version _1.20-1.21.1:_ The **background** of the resource pack **icon** shows black circle instead of it being transparent.
